study: Samsung Z Fold6 phone-side directory changes, one uninterrupted raw MTP session
observations: Prior host NFS and guest FUSE listings both missed www.txt; fresh raw MTP session saw it.
Phone-created dedicated file, rename, and delete were visible within the same raw MTP session.
Rename changed object handle from 1567 to 1568; file modification date stayed unchanged.
Parent directory modification date changed for all three observed operations.
No writes by probe. User removed dedicated test file; www.txt retained.
source_findings: AFT successful _files directory cache has no expiration.
FUSE attribute/entry timeout is 60 seconds; root/storage attributes use connection time.
Existing PollEvent path is not an active event invalidation implementation.
proposed_experiment: Bounded on-demand refresh of accessed directories, with atomic successful snapshot publication; no full-tree polling.
Reconcile object IDs/names/attributes and expose actual detected directory change through attributes used by NFS.
Treat phone parent mtime as optimization only, not sole correctness condition; test storage-root and same-second changes.
Preserve directory enumeration cookie semantics across refresh; validate large multi-page directories over NFS.
Measure end-to-end Finder visibility latency and copy throughput before choosing cache TTLs.
